text:
Maya: Quick planning thread — we need to pick 2 priorities for next sprint: (1) lightweight tracing hooks + basic UI, (2) a pragmatic cost-surface MVP (export + top-routes), (3) error-analytics pipeline. Engineering capacity ~2 major items. Sales asks for cost visibility for a couple renewals.

Leo: +1 on tracing hooks first. Traces unblock debugging and are lower infra cost. We can ship REST tracing headers + sample UI.

Ashley: Cost-surface MVP can be scoped to aggregated per-route and per-model estimates (no per-token accounting). That reduces ingestion complexity. We'll need a sampling strategy and a clear estimator note.

Ryan: Customer note — BrightEdge asked for per-customer cost rollups in the renewal demo. If we can't show something simple (even CSV), they'll push the timeline.

Olivia: Proposed combo: tracing hooks + CSV export for cost estimates (top routes). That satisfies BrightEdge and gives ops immediate value.

Maya: Draft sprint plan:
- Deliverables (2 wks): public tracing SDK + endpoint headers, small UI showing top routes by RPS/latency, CSV cost export by timeframe.
- Launch criteria:
  1) Tracing API + README + example snippets published.
  2) UI: Top-10 routes by RPS, median & p95 latency, simple link to trace details.
  3) CSV cost export: per-route, per-model estimated cost for selected timeframe.
  4) Infra guardrail: sampling default on, infra delta <=10% (monitoring alert).
- Pilot: offer BrightEdge pilot and provide sample CSV.

Leo: Tech caveat — cost estimates will be noisy if batching / KV caching not factored. Suggest we label CSV as "estimate" and include calc method. Also default sampling=0.1.

Ashley: I'll own sampling impl and an infra monitor. Plan: sample at ingress, tag traces with sample id, and run daily batch aggregator for CSV. Will add alert if infra spend > 8% above baseline.

Ryan: I'll draft BrightEdge one-pager + sample CSV walkthrough. Will include a section "approximation methodology" and a simple reconciliation example.

Olivia: UX ask — the tracing UI should allow quick linkouts to raw logs and the model/version in use. Keep it minimal: route, model, avg latency, p95, traces link.

Maya: Quick SDK example for tracing (Leo, pls include in the README):
```js
// tracing init example
import {initTracing} from '@redwood/instrumentation';
initTracing({
  service: 'checkout',
  sampleRate: 0.1,
});
// attach header: x-rd-trace-id
```

Leo: I'll open the tracing SDK PR today. It will include the header format and the example above.

Ashley: Infra tasks: sampling flag, aggregator job, infra monitor dashboard, cost estimate calc docs. ETA: Fri EOD for sampling + monitor.

Ryan: One-pager draft by Mon EOD, will loop in sales for BrightEdge sign-off.

Maya: Action list:
- @Leo: tracing SDK PR by EOD Wed (include example).
- @Ashley: sampling flag + infra monitor by Fri.
- @Ryan: BrightEdge one-pager by Mon.
- @Olivia: small UI mockups for top routes by Mon (low-fidelity).
Recheck Mon 10:00AM to finalize scope. Thanks all! :tada:
